title: sync_hop.c: Integer underflow in lichen_sfn_from_unix_ms
description: Line 42: (unix_time_ms - EPOCH_BASE_MS) underflows when unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS (1704067200000, i.e., before 2024-01-01). Both are uint64_t, so subtraction wraps to a large positive value, producing an incorrect SFN. If GNSS time source is spoofed or malformed to a pre-epoch timestamp, this yields an arbitrary SFN value that could desynchronize frequency hopping or, if SFN participates in replay protection, potentially enable replay attacks.
close_reason: Fixed: Added guard to return 0 when unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS, preventing unsigned integer underflow. Matches Python reference implementation behavior.
